EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for registering for Flywire's Dinner at HFMA Annual! Thank you for registering for Flywire's dinner. We are looking forward to a great event! ‌
When: Tuesday, June 25th | 6:30 PM - 9:00 PM PST ‌
Where: Rivea in Delano Las Vegas 3940 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89119
Directions: Mandalay Bay Convention Center to Rivea - Walk From the Convention Center Towards Delano Lobby. Rivea is Located on the 64th floor of Delano. Use guest elevators to enter. ‌
What: Enjoy a delicious dinner curated by Michelin star Chef Alain Ducasse, all while enjoying breathtaking views of the Las Vegas skyline from the 64th floor of the Delano hotel
